verdict.rationale: PostHog's product analytics docs explicitly describe building funnels, retention, and drop-off insights directly from events without needing a data team, plus dashboards/alerts for ongoing monitoring (posthog-docs-15, posthog-docs-25). PostHog AI further lets a non-technical founder ask plain-English questions and get insights/SQL built automatically (posthog-docs-35, posthog-supp-posthog-ai-analyst), reinforcing self-serve analysis. missing for 10: a concrete hands-on example/testimonial of a founder using funnels specifically to diagnose an activation drop-off, and independent (non-vendor) validation of ease-of-use for this exact workflow.
